name: desk-setup
description: A Claude Code skill that sets up your Sanduhr Desk as a conversation: it reads the screen and wallpaper, asks a few short questions, proposes a small look you Apply on the live preview, then offers a finishing widget such as a pixel companion or song looks. Windows, Sanduhr 3.7 or later (widgets need 3.8); Mac, Sanduhr 2.37 or later, one screen and no Launcher.
